name: Faralda NDSM Crane Hotel Amsterdam
description: Faralda occupies NDSM’s former Crane 13, built in 1950 and restored by Talsma in 2013. It opened as a hotel in 2014. Three suites sit at 35, 40 and 45 metres, with a rooftop jacuzzi above them; the restored steel is blue-gray and yellow, while new lifts and stairs are red.
